description: This file contains an extension for the ChannelsStore class, adding lifecycle management functions such as start, stop, refresh, and specific channel login/logout procedures (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram). It includes asynchronous network requests via GatewayConnection and manages internal state related to channel sessions.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginStartResult
classes.description: A struct representing the result of starting a WhatsApp login process, including QR code data URL and message.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginWaitResult
classes.description: A struct representing the result of waiting for WhatsApp login, indicating connection status and message.

classes.name: ChannelLogoutResult
classes.description: A struct representing the outcome of a channel logout request, including whether credentials were cleared and result details.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins polling and initializes the ChannelsStore, ensuring not to start if in preview mode or already polling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops polling by cancelling the poll task.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current channel status snapshot, optionally probing the status, updating internal state with the results or errors.

methods.name: startWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Initiates WhatsApp login; manages QR code data, login messages, and optional auto-wait for user login.

methods.name: waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for WhatsApp login to complete within a specified timeout period.

methods.name: logoutWhatsApp
methods.description: Logs out of WhatsApp channel, clearing credentials.

methods.name: logoutTelegram
methods.description: Logs out of Telegram channel, updating configuration status accordingly.
